presets.name: Classic High Fantasy
presets.pitch: Be the hero: quests, dragons, ancient evils and a kingdom worth saving.
sample_hooks: A dying knight presses a sealed map into your hands.
The village's children vanish the night the old tower relights.
A dragon demands tribute your town cannot pay.

presets.name: Dark & Gritty
presets.pitch: A bleak, low-magic world where nobody is clean and victories cost dearly.
typical_conflicts: a cult rotting a city from within
sample_hooks: The mercenary company that owns your debt has vanished, leaving only its ledger.
A bishop pays you to burn a village he calls heretical.
Your patron is executed and the mob turns on his staff, you included.

suggested_classes.why: mundane skill matters in low magic

presets.content_notes: Graphic violence, torture, abuse of power, despair, character death likely.

presets.name: Gothic Horror
presets.pitch: Mist, curses and things in the dark; fear is the point and hope is scarce.
typical_conflicts: an undying lord ruling a cursed land
a hungry thing in the fog
sample_hooks: The coach driver leaves you at a village where no one has aged in fifty years.
You inherit a house whose previous owners all died on the same date.
Every night the church bell rings once and someone is gone.

suggested_classes.why: turning the dead, holding back darkness

presets.content_notes: Body horror, undeath, madness, gore, bleak endings.

presets.name: Court Intrigue
presets.pitch: Words are weapons: alliances, betrayals and power games in a capital city.
sample_hooks: The heir is poisoned at a feast you catered.
A noble hires you to prove her rival forged the treaty.
You are handed a letter that could start a war and asked to lose it.
presets.content_notes: Assassination, betrayal, class oppression, occasional torture.

presets.name: Pirates & Swashbuckling
presets.pitch: Ships, sea monsters, duels on the rigging and buried treasure.
sample_hooks: Your captain is hanged at dawn unless someone steals the gallows key.
A half-map washes ashore in a bottle marked with your family crest.
A ghost ship signals for parley.
presets.content_notes: Piracy, slavery in colonial settings, drowning, execution.

presets.name: Wilderness Frontier
presets.pitch: Map the unknown: survive the wilds, find lost places, decide what gets built there.
sample_hooks: A surveyor returns from the valley alone, speaking a dead language.
The last caravan never arrived; you are the next.
A map shows a city where the river should be.
presets.content_notes: Starvation, exposure, animal death, colonial themes.

presets.name: City Underworld
presets.pitch: Solve crimes or commit them in a crowded, corrupt city of guilds and gangs.
sample_hooks: A body in the canal wears your face.
A fence offers a fortune for one painting in the magistrate's vault.
The guild's ledger is stolen and every faction blames you.

presets.name: The Great Dungeon
presets.pitch: A vast labyrinth beneath the earth; delve deeper each trip and come back richer, or not at all.
sample_hooks: The mine broke into something older and the miners never returned.
A guild posts bounties per level mapped.
A sealed door opens once a year; tomorrow.

presets.name: War Campaign
presets.pitch: Fight in a war between nations; missions, sieges and the people caught between.
sample_hooks: Your unit is ordered to hold a bridge for one night.
A deserter carries proof your side started the war.
The enemy's siege engine is powered by something that screams.
presets.content_notes: Mass death, war crimes, refugees, trauma themes.

presets.name: Weird & Cosmic
presets.pitch: Reality bends: other planes, strange realms, elder powers and impossible cities.
typical_conflicts: a bargain with an unknowable entity
common_locations: city at the crossroads of planes
sample_hooks: You wake in a city whose streets rearrange when nobody looks.
A star falls and asks for directions.
Your shadow leaves and files a complaint.
presets.content_notes: Existential dread, mind alteration, body horror.

presets.name: Fairy Tale & Whimsy
presets.pitch: Talking animals, tricky bargains and enchanted woods; light, funny, sometimes bittersweet.
sample_hooks: A fox in a waistcoat begs you to steal back the moon.
The princess trades places with a goose and prefers it.
Every promise made in the village becomes literally true.
presets.content_notes: Mild peril; original fairy-tale darkness (curses, child endangerment) optional.

presets.name: After the Cataclysm
presets.pitch: Magic broke the world; scavenge ruins, find water and rebuild among the ashes.
themes: the sins of the old world
typical_conflicts: the thing that ended the world stirring
sample_hooks: Your settlement's well dries and the only other water is in raider territory.
A pre-cataclysm machine hums awake beneath the market.
A stranger sells seeds nobody has seen in a century.
presets.content_notes: Starvation, scarcity violence, slavery by warlords, environmental horror.

presets.name: Sword & Sorcery
presets.pitch: Gritty, personal adventure in exotic, decadent lands; sinister sorcery and hard-won gold.
sample_hooks: A thief dies in your arms clutching a jeweled eye.
A queen hires you to steal back her stolen youth.
The city's priests demand a sacrifice and choose you.

presets.name: Mythic Legend
presets.pitch: Gods walk, prophecies bind and your deeds reshape the world.
sample_hooks: An oracle names you in a prophecy and the king wants you dead by sundown.
A god, exiled and mortal, asks for your protection.
The sun has not risen for three days.

session_zero_fields.name: Lines
session_zero_fields.help: Things that never appear in this story.

sources_note: Genre descriptions synthesised from public DM guidance (Daily Dungeon Master genre list, Artificial Twenty, DNDNames, The Alexandrian on megadungeons, Tribality on fairy-tale and post-apocalyptic play, TCK/Wikipedia on grimdark, StartPlaying and Daggerheart on session zero). No publisher product identity is used.
